title: Fix Map sheet chop and lag
description:
The last Map geometry heal forced every sheet to the theoretical ~2.8× display scale. Import already clamps sheet layout width to 8000px, so real scale is often lower. Forcing 2.8 made the PDF media larger than the sheet box (half-chopped pages) and kept kicking full-DPI re-rasters (heavy lag).

Heal now only fixes clearly bad nat sizes or scale overflow, and derives display scale from layout ÷ native size so media fits the box. No full zoom re-raster from that path.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace.
changeLog: Stop forcing map sheets to 2.8× when layout is clamped to 8000px.
Heal scale overflow so pages are not half-chopped.
Remove full-DPI re-raster loop that made Map Builder laggy.
